methodologyNotes: Dataset covers 10 current-market adjustable dumbbell models, each independently re-verified 2026-06-15 against primary sources: official manufacturer product pages (bowflex.com, powerblock.com, nordictrack.com, smrtft.com, corehomefitness.com, proform.com), major retailers (Rogue Fitness, Target, Best Buy, Amazon, Walmart), and the CPSC recall database. Prices are published USD MSRPs or current buy-now prices for the EXACT named model/config; 'pair' means two dumbbells; 'weight_settings' = count of distinct selectable weights per dumbbell; 'adjustment_type' = locking/selection mechanism. Corrections made: Yes4All plate inventory in provenance was fabricated (corrected to 4x2.5lb + 4x5lb plates per retailer listings); NordicTrack adjustment-mechanism wording overstated ('outer pin + inner slide' replaced with verified spring-loaded sliding pin description); NUOBELL 50lb source swapped from a non-specific collection URL to a topical product listing. All other headline prices and specs corroborated. accessedAt 2026-06-15.

products.name: BowFlex Results Series 552 SelectTech Dumbbells
products.priceNote: MSRP per pair; sale price observed at $328.99 on bowflex.com
products.provenance: Verified on official Bowflex product page (resolves to Results Series 552): name 'Results Series 552 SelectTech Dumbbells', 5–52.5 lb range, 15 weight settings (5,7.5,...,52.5), dual selection dials, sold as pair, MSRP $479 with $328.99 sale. Results Series launched 2025 as replacement for the original 552, which was recalled June 5, 2025 by Johnson Health Tech Trading / CPSC (plate-dislodging impact hazard, ~3.8M units).

products.name: BowFlex Results Series 1090 SelectTech Dumbbells
products.priceNote: MSRP per pair; sale/promo prices observed around $699
products.provenance: Verified on official Bowflex product page and corroborating retailer listings: 10–90 lb range, 5 lb increments, 17 weight settings, dual selection dials, sold as pair, MSRP $799 (promo ~$699). Results Series launched 2025 as replacement for the recalled original 1090 (CPSC recall June 5, 2025).

products.name: NordicTrack 55 Lb. Select-A-Weight Dumbbells
products.priceNote: MSRP per pair (confirmed at Target $399.99); street price ~$350 at some retailers
products.provenance: Official NordicTrack page plus Target confirm 55 lb max per dumbbell, 15 weight settings (10,12.5,15,20,22.5,25,30,32.5,35,40,42.5,45,50,52.5,55 — mix of 2.5 and 5 lb steps), spring-loaded sliding-pin selection, sold as pair. MSRP $399.99 confirmed at Target; reviews note ~$350 street price. Note: draft's 'outer pin + inner slide' wording was an overstatement of the mechanism and has been corrected to the verified spring-loaded sliding pin.

products.name: PowerBlock Elite USA 90 EXP Adjustable Dumbbells

Pricing tiers verified on page: $469 (50 lb), $668 (70 lb), $867 (90 lb). Elite USA is a distinct line from Elite EXP.

products.name: Core Home Fitness Adjustable Dumbbell Weight Set (5–50 lb)
products.provenance: Official Core Home Fitness page confirmed 5–50 lb range, 5 lb increments, twist-handle adjustment (no knobs/levers), 10 weight settings, sold as pair, dual-sided weight selection window. Price $399.99 sale (was $429.99); BarBend corroborated specs.

products.name: SMRTFT NUOBELL 50lb Adjustable Dumbbells
products.provenance: Confirmed $595 pair price for the 5–50 lb NUOBELL, 5 lb increments, 10 weight settings (one per 5 lb step), twist-lock mechanism identical to 80 lb model. products.name: Yes4All 40 lb Adjustable Cast Iron Dumbbell Set
products.priceNote: Approximate pair price (varies ~$49–$70 across Amazon/Walmart; observed $62.48); no published manufacturer MSRP. Set totals 40 lb (20 lb per dumbbell max)
products.provenance: Retailer listings confirmed the Yes4All 40 lb set includes two chrome handles (~14"), four 2.5 lb plates, four 5 lb plates, and four spinlock/star-lock collars, yielding up to 20 lb per dumbbell. CORRECTION: draft's plate inventory ('two 5 lb + two 3 lb each') was fabricated — actual is 4x2.5lb + 4x5lb. Adjustment is spinlock collar (plate-loaded, classified as pin-type). Price ranged ~$49–$70 across Walmart/Amazon (observed $62.48); no published manufacturer MSRP, so mid-range $60 with wide caveat. Manufacturer does not specify distinct weight-setting count, so weight_settings = null.

products.name: ProForm Rapid Strike 50 Lb. Adjustable Dumbbell Set
products.priceNote: Per pair; $299 confirmed at Best Buy and other retailers
products.provenance: Official ProForm page confirmed 10–50 lb range, 10 lb increments (so 5 weight settings: 10/20/30/40/50), sold as pair with storage trays, and the 'Rapid Weight Selector' mechanism (a pull/slide selector). $299 confirmed at Best Buy and other retailers. adjustment_type retained as 'dial' as a defensible bucket for the selector, though the mechanism is technically a sliding/pull selector rather than a rotary dial — noted for accuracy.

products.name: Ironmaster Quick-Lock Adjustable Dumbbell System (75 lb)
products.priceNote: US MSRP $699.00 per pair (set) from the official Ironmaster product page (SKU 75-2). Retailer Northern Fitness lists CAD $999.00 regular / $829.00 sale — CAD, not used for the USD figure.
products.provenance: Official Ironmaster product page (SKU 75-2, titled "Quick-Lock Adjustable Dumbbell System 75 lb Set") confirms the exact model: adjust 5–75 lb each dumbbell in 2.5 lb increments, sold as 1 pair (two handles + four locking screws, 24×5 lb + 4×2.5 lb plates), 75 lb max per dumbbell, and expandable via 120 lb / 165 lb add-on kits — MSRP stated as $699.00. Northern Fitness (SKU IRM.75-2) corroborates the identical specs (5–75 lb, 2.5 lb increments, 150 lb total, add-on expandable) but prices in CAD ($999 regular / $829 sale), so only the manufacturer's US $699.00 is used for priceUsd. adjustment_type is left null because the Quick-Lock threaded locking-screw mechanism ("add or remove plates with just a partial turn of the locking screws") does not map to the dataset's existing dial/pin/twist buckets, and weight_settings is left null because neither page states an explicit selectable-setting count.

products.name: Snode AD80 Drop-Proof Cast Iron Adjustable Dumbbells (80 lb)
products.priceNote: List/MSRP per pair. snodesport.com shows "Sale price $795.00" for the "1 Pair of AD80s" variant (SKU AD80*2), with compare_at_price also 79500 (regular = sale, no active discount). ShreddedDad review corroborates: "currently retail for $795". The "+ 8 Magnet Weight Plates" bundle is a separate variant at $854.99.
products.provenance: Official Snode product page (title "Snode AD80 Drop-proof Cast Iron Adjustable Dumbbells 80 LB", SKU AD80*2; the /ad80-drop-proof-full-cast-iron... URL redirects to this canonical page) confirms the exact model: "10 to 80LB weight range", "8 weight settings", "Fast single-dial adjustment" via an "adjustment dial on the side of the handle" (handle fixed), "Single Dumbbell Weight: 80lbs", sold as "1 Pair of AD80s" priced "$795.00". ShreddedDad's hands-on review corroborates identity, price, and specs verbatim: "Snode's range is from 10 – 80 lbs in 10 lbs increments", "replace 8 pairs", "adjusted with a black plastic dial", and "currently retail for $795". The 10 lb increment is stated explicitly only in the review (the manufacturer page gives range + 8 settings but not the increment figure); expandable=false because max weight is fixed at 80 lb — the optional 1.25 lb magnetic adder plates add finer increments below the max, not range expansion. Walmart's listing was bot-blocked, so the dated review serves as corroboration; releaseDate left null as no page states an explicit release year.

products.name: REP Fitness QuickDraw Adjustable Dumbbell (5–60 lb)
products.priceNote: MSRP per pair for the 60lb Pair configuration; $575.99 on repfitness.com (SKU DBS-6000-560). Other sizes price lower: 30lb Pair $335.99, 40lb Pair $415.99, 50lb Pair $495.99 — the $335.99 shown on the default product page is the 30 lb base, not this 5–60 lb model.
products.provenance: Verified on REP Fitness's official product page with the 60lb variant selected (variant=42748506144926 → "60lb Pair", SKU DBS-6000-560): title "QuickDraw™ - Adjustable Dumbbell (LB)", 5–60 lb range ("The minimum weight of the adjustable dumbbell is 5lbs. The maximum weight is 60lbs"), Lock-N-Load steel-switch weight selection, sold as a pair, and expandable via add-on plates; the page also states a 60 lb pair replaces "12 pairs of fixed dumbbells (5lbs-60lbs)", giving 12 five-pound settings, with 5 lb standard increments plus 2.5 lb micro-adjustment plates. Price $575.99 for the 60lb Pair is shown on that variant page and independently corroborated by REP's product-data (.json) endpoint, which lists the 60lb Pair variant at 575.99 (SKU DBS-6000-560) and confirms the lower tiers (30/40/50 lb = $335.99/$415.99/$495.99) — so the $335.99 on the default page is the 30 lb base, not this model. adjustment_type is recorded as "switch" because the mechanism explicitly described (flip-switch Lock-N-Load) does not match the existing dial/pin/twist buckets; no independent retailer/review carried this exact model (sold direct only), so REP's authoritative .json is used as corroboration.

products.name: MX Select EVO MX55 Adjustable Dumbbells
products.priceNote: MX Select's manufacturer product page publishes no price. The MX Fitness Supply reseller (mxfitnesssupply.com) lists the "MX55 Evolution Series" at "Sale price $449.00 / Regular price $599.00" (Save $150.00, a 4th-of-July promo); priceUsd=599 uses the regular price as the durable figure, with the $449 sale noted. Same pricing covers both handle variants (MX55R rubber / MX55K knurled), sold as a pair. No manufacturer MSRP found.
products.provenance: Official MX Select page (source) confirms model identity as the EVO MX55 (model no. MX55CR, the 10–55 lb adjustable Evolution system — distinct from the legacy single-weight MX55): "Weight Range 10-55 lbs in 5 lb increment," 55 lb max per dumbbell ("MAX 55lbs"), 10 selectable weight levels (expandable to 20 via Magnetic Increment Weight Plates), and a patented rack-and-pinion "dial" selector ("UNBREAKABLE DIAL SELECTOR") with Positive Lock System. The MX Fitness Supply reseller page (corroboration) confirms the same 10–55 lb / 5 lb-increment / dial specs for the "MX55 Evolution Series," states it is SOLD AS PAIR in both MX55R rubber and MX55K knurled variants, and that an optional MX EVO 2.5×4 increment kit "can be added to the MX 55 EVO to increase the max weight range of the MX55 Evo to 60lbs" (basis for expandable=true). Price is reseller-sourced only: Regular $599.00 with a $449.00 sale; the manufacturer page carries no price.

products.name: Flybird 55 lb Adjustable Dumbbells
products.priceNote: Regular price $398.00 USD per pair ("55LBS - Set of 2") on fedfitness.com, the official Flybird store (flybirdfitness.com redirects there); listed sold out at access. The Gadgeteer's dated review (2024) observed a promotional $348.88 with a site-wide code.
products.provenance: Official Flybird store (flybirdfitness.com now redirects to fedfitness.com) lists this as the "FED Fitness Flybird Series DB2 Quick Adjustable Dumbbell 55LBS", sold as a pair (variant "55LBS - Set of 2"; FAQ: "the set comes with two dumbbells—that is, one pair") at a regular price of $398.00 USD, with a spec table stating "Weight Increments 10lbs; From 15, 25, 35, 45 and 55 pounds with just a twist of the handle" (5 settings, 55 lb max per dumbbell) and carbon-steel plates coated in nylon. The Gadgeteer's dated review (Feb 10, 2024) confirms the exact model — a pair of 55 lb dumbbells switching between 15, 25, 35, 45 and 55 lb "with just a twist of the handle," 19"L x 8.5"W x 8"H per dumbbell — observing a $348.88 promo price. Model identity confirmed as the 55 lb twist-handle Flybird dumbbell (DB2); adjustment_type set to "twist" to match this dataset's treatment of identical rotate-the-handle mechanisms (NUOBELL, Core Home), though the manufacturer's spec label also calls it a "rotating dial".

products.name: PowerBlock Pro 100 EXP Adjustable Dumbbells
products.priceNote: MSRP per pair at full 100 lb configuration (Knurled grip), $1196 on powerblock.com; base 40 lb config $539, 60 lb $758, 80 lb $977 (all per pair). $539 base price independently corroborated by The Jungle Gym Reviews ("The 40 pound version is $539").
products.provenance: Official PowerBlock product data (powerblock.com Pro 100 EXP endpoint; title "Pro 100 EXP", vendor "PowerBlock", SKU 750-00331-00) confirms the exact model and its per-pair USD MSRPs verbatim: $539 (40 LBS base), $758 (60 LBS), $977 (80 LBS) and $1196 (100 LBS Knurled), with body copy stating it can "expand up to 100 lbs" via Stages 2–4 (+20 lb each), "2.5 lb to 5 lb increments," and a "magnetic selector pin"; the German HTML page (geo-redirected, showing the same variant at 45 kg) additionally states "Sold as a pair." The Jungle Gym Reviews dated hands-on review corroborates the same model — "goes from 5 to 100 pounds in 2.5 pound increments," a 5 lb base handle, and a 40 lb starting version at $539 expandable to 100 lb — and explicitly distinguishes it from the sibling Elite USA 90 (which tops out at 90 lb and lacks urethane coating), confirming this is the Pro 100 EXP and not a variant. weight_settings is left null because no fetched page states a discrete selectable-setting count.
